purpose: TRID fee tolerance analysis and cure calculation per Reg Z §1026.19(e)(3). Classifies each closing fee into zero-tolerance, ten-percent cumulative, or no-tolerance-limit bucket. Computes 10% bucket aggregate overage, identifies violations, and returns the cure amount required to make the consumer whole under TRID.
